guarantee.title: Why employers like this model
guarantee.line1: You see the candidate's real, verified profile before you commit a single euro
guarantee.line2: Your offer states salary, hours and benefits — candidates decide with the full picture
guarantee.line3: An anonymous candidate can block your company by name — competition happens on the offer, not the brand
